svt_mipi_dsi_dual_configuration Class Reference

List of all members.

Detailed Description

This class defines the configuration data and methods used to configure Dual DSI VIP. In general, the user shall provide specific configuration in order to connect the DUT to VIP.

 svt_mipi_dsi_dual_configuration::reasonable_fsc_commands

  [
(10 - ((10 - 0)/5)) : 10 ] :/ 1
                             };

  constraint
 svt_mipi_dsi_dual_configuration::valid_ranges

Valid constraint for Dual DSI Configuration fields.
constraint valid_ranges {
    num_active_ports inside {[1: 3]};
     foreach (dsi_cfg[i]) {
      if(i > 0) dsi_cfg[i].interface_type == dsi_cfg[i-1].interface_type;
    }
     foreach(dsi_cfg[i]) {
      lane_cfg[i].eot_processing_enable == dsi_cfg[i].eot_processing_enable;
    }
     dsi_cfg.size() inside {[1: 3]};
    lane_cfg.size() inside {[1: 3]};
    fsc_ids.size() inside {[0: 6]};
    fsc_commands.size() inside {[0: 10]};
    num_overlap_pixels inside {[0: 50]};
    num_dummy_pixels inside {[0: 50]};
    lane_cfg.size() == dsi_cfg.size();
    num_active_ports <= dsi_cfg.size();
         num_vss_te_pkt_no_fsc inside {[2: 2]};
    num_vss_te_pkt_execute_fsc inside {[1: 1]};
    num_vss_te_pkt_no_fsc > num_vss_te_pkt_execute_fsc;
     foreach(fsc_ids[i]) {
      foreach(fsc_ids[j]) {
        if(i != j) { fsc_ids[i] != fsc_ids[j];}
      }
    }
     foreach(fsc_commands[i]) {
      foreach(fsc_commands[j]) {
        if(i != j) { fsc_commands[i] != fsc_commands[j];}
      }
    }
  }
